description_en: Changes the billing method of a specified delivery group to a target billing method and returns the ID of the billing conversion task to be created
description_zh: 将指定交付组变更为目标付费方式，并返回需要创建的计费转换任务标识
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center modify-app-instance-group-charge-type --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --product-type CloudApp --app-instance-group-ids '["aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****"]' --charge-type PrePaid --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAppInstanceGroupChargeType

parameters.help_en: The business region ID of the target delivery group. It must be the same as the actual region to which the resource belongs
parameters.help_zh: 目标交付组所在的业务地域ID，必须与该资源实际所属地域一致
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Set this parameter to one of the following values when you call the operation:

CloudApp: Wuying Cloud Application
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。调用时固定填写以下取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The list of delivery group IDs to be modified, in JSON array format. You must and can only specify one item at a time. The resource must belong to the current account, the specified product, and the business region
parameters.help_zh: 待变更的交付组标识列表，采用JSON数组形式。一次必须且只能填写1项，资源须属于当前账号、指定产品和业务地域
parameters.name: app_instance_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The target billing method after conversion. It must be different from the current billing method. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
转换后的目标付费方式，必须与当前方式不同。

`PrePaid`：包年包月付费。
`PostPaid`：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the promotion used for this conversion order. It takes effect only when an order is created and the promotion is applicable. If omitted, no specific coupon is specified. The availability of the promotion is subject to the order result
parameters.help_zh: 本次转换订单使用的优惠ID。仅在创建订单并适用该优惠时生效；省略时不指定某一张优惠券。优惠是否可用以订单结果为准
parameters.name: promotion_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow automatic payment for this conversion order. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: allows automatic payment for the conversion order.
false: does not allow automatic payment. If an unpaid order is generated, you must complete the payment separately
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许自动支付本次转换订单。默认值：`false`。

`true`：允许自动支付转换订单。
`false`：不自动支付；如产生待支付订单需另行完成支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for this order. Explicitly specify this parameter for subscription orders to determine whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
本次订单是否启用自动续费。涉及包年包月订单时建议显式填写，以确定是否启用自动续费。

`true`：申请启用自动续费。
`false`：不启用自动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The numeric part of the purchase duration, used together with PeriodUnit. Specify this parameter along with PeriodUnit when converting to subscription and a purchase duration is required. For example, 1 and Month indicate a purchase duration of one month. The specific available purchase durations are determined by the sales rules of the target resource
parameters.help_zh: 购买时长的数量部分，与 `PeriodUnit` 一起使用。转换为包年包月并需要购买时长时应一并填写；示例 `1` 与 `Month` 表示购买1个月。具体可购买时长由目标资源的售卖规则决定
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the purchase duration, used together with Period. This parameter is case-sensitive. Valid values:

Hour: hour.
Day: day.
Week: week.
Month: month.
Year: year.

These units do not mean that every product supports any combination. When converting to subscription, select a period supported by the target resource. For example, for a resource that supports monthly purchase, you can set Period=1 and PeriodUnit=Month
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长单位，与 `Period` 一起使用，区分大小写。已定义单位如下：

`Hour`：小时。
`Day`：天。
`Week`：周。
`Month`：月。
`Year`：年。

这些单位不代表每种产品都可以购买任意组合。转换为包年包月时应选择目标资源支持的周期，例如支持按月购买的资源可使用 `Period=1`、`PeriodUnit=Month`
parameters.name: period_unit

schema.description_en: The response information for this operation

AppInstanceGroupModel.description_en: The task information for this billing method conversion
AppInstanceGroupModel.description_zh: 本次付费方式转换的任务信息

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the billing conversion order task, used to associate with this conversion. It is returned only when a related order task is required and created. It does not indicate that the payment is completed or the new billing method has taken effect
TaskId.description_zh: 计费转换订单任务的标识，用于关联本次转换。仅在需要并创建相关订单任务时返回；不代表支付完成或付费方式已经生效

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题
